faq: Can you set prices for different countries?
Where your platform supports market pricing, yes. We set it up with the exchange rules you choose. Tell us the countries and currencies, and whether prices should include tax.
How do you avoid pricing mistakes?
We back up current prices first, show you the new ones in a sheet and test discount stacking in a real cart before the sale starts. If a rule behaves oddly, we fix it before launch.
Do you decide what my prices should be?
No, you set the numbers or the rule, such as a percentage or a margin. We can point out risks, like a discount that stacks with another, but pricing strategy stays with you.
Do the discount rules work with my apps?
Usually, yes. Some discount or bundle apps change how discounts combine, so we test with the apps you actually use. Any paid app is billed to you by its maker.

desc:
Product pricing and discount setup covers every place a price lives in your store: product prices, compare-at prices, variants, discount codes and automatic discounts. Ecom Swift LLC plans the change with you, builds it, tests it in a real cart and gives you a sheet of old and new prices.

## What does pricing and discount setup include?

Pricing setup means changing the numbers shoppers see and the rules that adjust those numbers at checkout. That includes the base price, a compare-at price that shows the previous price crossed out, variant prices, discount codes, automatic discounts and shipping thresholds.

Discount setup is the rule layer. A code might take a share off one collection, an automatic discount might apply to orders above a set value, and a tiered offer might reward buying more of the same item. Each rule needs conditions, limits and dates, and each must work correctly beside the others.

## Why price changes go wrong

Prices appear in more places than most owners expect. A product can have a price, a compare-at price, several variant prices, a bundle price and a market-specific price. Change one and forget another, and a shopper sees a crossed-out price that is lower than the current one, or a discount that stacks with a code you never meant to combine.

Timing causes trouble as well. A sale that starts an hour late wastes your email and ad traffic. A sale that never ends keeps margins thin long after the campaign. Careful scheduling and a plan for restoring prices protect against both.

## How pricing affects conversions and margin

Price is one of the clearest signals a shopper reads. A clear compare-at price shows the saving. A visible free shipping threshold encourages a larger basket. Buy-more-save-more offers can raise the amount in each order without extra advertising. These work because they make the benefit obvious at the moment of decision.

Margin matters as much as volume. A discount that stacks by accident can push a product below cost. Testing every rule in a real cart before it goes live shows exactly what the shopper pays, so you spend on offers deliberately. What the right price is remains your call. We do not decide your pricing, we apply it accurately.

## What a well-run price update includes

- A written plan listing which products, which variants and which dates are covered.
- A backup of existing prices before any change.
- Compare-at prices set only where a genuine previous price exists.
- Variant-level updates, so every size and color carries the intended price.
- Discount codes with clear conditions, usage limits and end dates.
- Automatic discounts that do not conflict with codes.
- A cart test of every rule, using different baskets.
- Sale start and end scheduled where the platform allows.
- A free shipping threshold that fits your shipping rates.
- A restore file or sheet for returning prices to normal after the sale.

## How we handle it

First you tell us what you want: a seasonal sale, a supplier-driven rise, a new tier or a clean-up. If you have a spreadsheet of target prices, send it. Otherwise we apply the rule you describe, such as a fixed share off a collection.

We back up current prices, make the changes, then build each discount rule. Every rule is tested in a real cart with different combinations of products. The Basic package covers a sale or update on a small group with one rule. Standard handles a bigger group, several rules, variant-level changes and scheduling. Premium adds tiered offers, a free shipping threshold and a restore file. You receive the old and new price sheet so you can check any product in seconds.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide your lowest acceptable margin before choosing a discount.
- Schedule the end of a sale when you schedule the start.
- Test as a shopper would, on a phone, with a clean cart.
- Keep one sheet of old prices for easy restoring.

**Avoid:**
- Showing a compare-at price that was never the real price.
- Stacking several discounts without checking the total.
- Changing prices during a live campaign without telling the team.
- Forgetting prices on other channels that sync with your store.

## Who this service is for

It suits a merchant preparing a holiday or clearance sale who needs many products repriced quickly. It suits a seller whose supplier raised costs and who must adjust prices across variants. It also suits a store owner who wants a tiered offer, such as a lower price when buying more, but is unsure how to set it up without errors.

## What we need and how to begin

Tell us the goal, the products involved and the dates. Send new prices or the rule to follow. We ask for collaborator or staff access, never your password. Please mention any apps that touch pricing, such as bundle or currency tools, since those can affect how rules behave.
